name: @outreachr/agents
description: Fail-closed, proposal-only local Codex and Claude agent runtime for Outreachr

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', 'coverage']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test:unit: vitest run test/policy.test.ts test/output.test.ts test/prompt.test.ts test/runtime.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
